The module automatically updates values in core_config_data, ensuring correct settings for web/unsecure/base_url and other configurations.

fact_previews: Magento - Environments provides functionalities available in Admin > System > Environments.
Magento - Environments includes filters like Configuration, Environments, and Scopes (Global, Website, Store).
All filter options in Magento - Environments are generated dynamically based on data from core_config_data.
Magento - Environments features a grid table that allows comparison and setting of different values in core_config_data for Development, Staging, or Pre-Production environments.
Magento - Environments includes a snapshot functionality that shows a history of all changes made in System > Configuration.

fact_previews: Magento - Environments works with a permanently synced copy of core_config_data.
A method called sync will perform actions when the host name matches with one of the servers in Admin > System > Environments > Server.
If a host name doesn't match with any entry in Admin > System > Environments > Server, Magento - Environments will not make any changes in core_config_data.
